args:
while true; do
  if nodes=$(kubectl get nodes --no-headers) \
    && pods=$(kubectl get pods --all-namespaces --no-headers) \
    && kubectl get --raw /metrics > /dev/null; then
    echo "[collector] nodes: $(echo "$nodes" | wc -l) pods: $(echo "$pods" | wc -l) apiserver metrics ok"
    touch /tmp/ok
  else
    echo "[collector] scrape failed"
  fi
  sleep 60
done
containers.name: collector

args:
mb=$(cat /ledger/megabytes)
echo "[scrolls] warming ${mb} MB of the ledger"
ledger=$(head -c "${mb}000000" /dev/zero | tr '\0' 'l')
echo "[scrolls] ledger warm (${#ledger} bytes), serving"
while true; do sleep 3600; done
containers.name: scrolls-app
